title: This dude is benchmarking/speedrunning my game (thank you, whoever you are)
author: Right_Building_8032
selftext:
Hello !

I launched an Android game about 2-3 weeks ago, and you can make a virtually infinite number of successive runs. But I'm not here to make promotion about it.

That being said, someone popped like 2 weeks ago.  
He began playing every single day (while, I'll be honest, most players didnt, they either try once a full run and stop, or come once every 2-3 days at most).

And he plays A LOT. Not just one fight to earn his daily missions.  
Just to have an idea, a fight early is around 1mn at most, but since difficulty rises and fights are longer (and runs are longer and longer too), I'd say at his actual level it's around 5mn per fight (maybe ? I think way more, I don't even know myself !)

  
And he's today at his 12th run, 111 FIGHTS WON ! AND WITHOUT PAYING ! He's litterally sprinting through the game and probably enjoying it, for free. And that's awesome, since I didnt wanna make a pay to win game.

Anyway, you know what's funny ? I thought noone, even paying player, would get past 12th successive run until like what... a month or two ?

He's forcing me to put more challenges, more content, at a faster pace than intended.  
And I love him for it.  
I'd love to know why he seems to love my game and what pushes him to play it every single day.  
But I'd like to say to him :    
  
**Thank you !** Thank you for making me feel like at least one dude likes it. Thank you for pushing me, for challenging me. You're only playing a game on your side, but that means a lot for me.

  
I'm spending way more money and time on the game than I earn from it (0 atm), but I don't care, if at least THAT DUDE enjoys it, it's okay.

Oh and while I'm at it : if there are some game builders here, did it happen to you and what did you feel ?

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body: I recently built [https://botgambit.com](https://botgambit.com) over the past month or so. Over 11k games played so far, mindblowing. I have multiple users with 300+ games. In hindsight, it's pretty nuts. I'm just excited to continue going and make the site the best it can be.
